Sunnyside Backyard

Labraduck

Labrador + Duck

Option A

A bright quack with the body of a single bark.

Option B

A low, rumbling guard call with a duck accent.

Option C

Two quick notes with an answering woof in the second.

Bunblebee

Bumblebee + Rabbit

Option A

Wing swell. A single bumblebee fly-by with a rabbit oink emerging from the buzz.

Option B

Curious oinks. A pair of quick rabbit calls with a low wing hum underneath.

Option C

Double flutter. Two naturally different bumblebee passes, with a rabbit grunt folded into the second pulse.

Cockapoodle

Cockatoo + Poodle

Option A

Bright yap. A fast poodle bark with a sharp cockatoo note opening into its tail.

Option B

Questioning squawk. A longer cockatoo roll with a low poodle accent near the end.

Option C

Double alert. Two cockatoo pulses with the sharper poodle onset tucked into the second.

Humminglow

Ruby-throated Hummingbird + Big Dipper Firefly

Softer keyboard-style mix

A Curtos firefly relative supplies the slowed wing clicks.

Pocket sparkle

Two round keys step upward, with a hummingbird chirp and soft firefly ticks tucked into the lift.

Bubble button

A soft boing drops to a lower note, with a short hummingbird reply and two measured firefly taps.

Firefly peep

A round key opens a playful three-beat call, with quick insect taps and a hummingbird note at the crest.

Ladymole

Eastern Mole + Seven-spotted Lady Beetle

Softer keyboard-style mix

Common shrew supplies the mole layer. A dung beetle supplies the lady beetle layer.

Sweet burrow ping

A soft, rising keyboard note with a rounded animal chirp underneath.

Warm burrow pluck

A lower wooden-key pluck settles into a short, earthy reply.

Burrow bounce

Two rounded keyboard notes bounce up, with a different animal inflection on each beat.

Clover Farm

Cluckitty

Chicken + Kitten

Curious mewl

A soft kitten-led call with a pulsing cluck inside its attack.

Purr-cluck

A quick, chicken-led call with a short kitten reply folded into its tail.

Question trill

A gentler, drawn-out kitten call with short hen notes that break up the middle.

Donkeyote

Donkey + Coyote

Option A

Rolling hee-yip. A forward donkey bray curls into a coyote howl.

Option B

Double warning. A sharp coyote bark leads into two clipped donkey pulses.

Option C

Low prairie call. A heavier bray holds under a smoother, airy howl.

Flamingoat

Flamingo + Goat

Option A

Breezy honk. A short flamingo opening with a clear goat note carrying the sound forward.

Option B

Stuttering bleat. A goat-led call with little flamingo pulses inside its held note.

Option C

Double honk. Two flamingo phrases separated by a compact goat answer.

Woolrus

Sheep + Walrus

Option A

Baa-rumble. A rounded sheep bleat that takes on a walrus rumble as it starts.

Option B

Short huff. A compact walrus grunt with a lighter sheep reply.

Option C

Rolling baa. A pair of walrus pulses shapes a sheep note into a bouncy call.

Puglet

Pig + Pug

Option A

Snort-bark. A round pig grunt turns into one dry, close pug bark.

Option B

Double snuffle. Two quick pug barks with a pig snuffle underneath each beat.

Option C

Squeaky grumble. A pig squeak dips into a low, gruff pug bark.

Alpanda

Alpaca + Panda

Option A

Rising hum. A round alpaca hum lifts into a clear panda bleat.

Option B

Curious pair. Two gently spaced notes with a warmer panda answer.

Option C

Soft hiccup. A bright alpaca chirrup falls into a lower panda moan.

Ripplewater Lake

Crocodoodle Doo

Crocodile + Rooster

Raspy dawn crow

A rising rooster crow with a Nile crocodile chirr threaded through its middle.

Sharp river chirr

A low juvenile crocodile chirr with a short rooster accent.

Two-note wake-up call

A brief blend opens the call, followed by a higher crow with a second crocodile chirr.

Goosemoose

Canada Goose + Moose

Bright antler honk

A clear Canada goose honk with a low moose note beneath it.

Deep marsh call

A moose-led grunt with the goose honk rising out of the middle.

Double honk

Two short calls, with a brighter first honk and a heavier answering one.

Hootopotamus

Owl + Hippopotamus

Round hoot

A rounded owl hoot with a short hippo grunt tucked into its attack.

Swamp bellow

A chesty hippo bellow with an owl tone swelling over it.

Two-step hoot

A short grunt-hoot followed by a fuller, higher hoot.

Hamsturtle

Hamster + Turtle

New recordings

Pet hamster and giant South American river turtle recordings.

Little shell chirp

A small high hamster peep answers a rounded hatchling turtle pulse.

Hello from the shell

A gentle hamster note leads into a clean, low turtle reply.

Two tiny peeps

Two soft hamster notes surround a short turtle hatchling pulse.

Acorn Woods

Koalameleon

Koala + Chameleon

Low leaf huff

A compact koala bellow softens into a close chameleon breath.

Sharp inhale

A quick chameleon intake leads into a short, brighter koala reply.

Two dry breaths

A low koala pulse connects two short chameleon breaths.

Porcupython

Porcupine + Python

Softer keyboard-style mix

A guinea pig, a fellow caviomorph rodent, supplies the porcupine layer.

Quill keys

Two soft rising keyboard notes with a small squeak at the start and a breath in the middle.

Cozy curl

A descending keyboard pair opens out into a round low breath before a tiny guinea pig chirp.

Button bounce

A cushioned rising keyboard slide sits between two short squeaks over a quiet python puff.

Badgermunk

American Badger + Eastern Chipmunk

High frequencies softened

The library badger recording does not identify the species.

Burrow call

A rounded badger grunt opens into a short chipmunk chirp.

Quick scold

The chipmunk calls first and a two-part badger bark answers.

Double chip

A softer badger puff threads between two closely spaced chipmunk notes.

Botterfly

Butterfly + Otter

High frequencies softened

Flutter squeak

A close wing flutter lifts into one rounded otter squeak.

Pocket takeoff

An otter peep lifts into two quick wing flicks and a soft squeak.

Wing chatter

Two little otter calls overlap a fanning butterfly wing.

Skunkle Ant

Striped Skunk + Black Garden Ant

High frequencies softened

A jet-black ant in the same genus supplies the black garden ant layer.

Quick warning snuff

A short skunk snuff rises into a compact ant chirr.

Low curious grumble

A lowered skunk note and an ant pulse overlap in a longer call.

Two alert chirps

Two small ant chirps sit around a clipped skunk exhale.

Jungle Wilds

Tigebra

Tiger + Zebra

Option A

Low rattling growl. A tiger growl rolls into a short burst of zebra chatter.

Option B

Quick nasal snap. A bright zebra bark has a short tiger snarl underneath.

Option C

Rising rasp. A longer zebra bray rises into an open tiger roar.

Peacockybara

Peacock + Capybara

Bright fan call

A rising peacock call with a brief capybara squeak tucked into its middle.

Low answering call

The capybara leads, followed by a lowered peacock call that fades at the end.

Quick double call

Two short peacock notes frame a brighter capybara squeak.

Tapirrot

Tapir + Scarlet Macaw

High frequencies softened

A rhinoceros from the tapir's closest living sister family supplies the snort.

Short jungle greeting

A compact snort opens into a bright macaw note.

Low canopy snort

A lower macaw note blends into a longer, round snort.

Two-note crest chatter

Two short macaw notes are joined by a small snort in the middle.

Rainbow Coral Reef

Pelicanary

Pelican + Canary

New recordings

Reef chirp

A round pelican note opens into a bright canary chirp.

Quick head turn

A canary chirp calls first and a short pelican grunt replies.

Double croon

Two rounded pelican notes surround a softer canary trill.

Golden Dunes

Swobra

Swan + Cobra

Option A

Trumpet hiss. A rounded swan call opens into a soft cobra hiss.

Option B

Striking call. The cobra snaps first, with a darker swan note swelling behind it.

Option C

Fluttering double call. Two lighter swan pulses chatter through a quick hiss.

Vulturkey

Turkey Vulture + Wild Turkey

New recordings

Library vulture and turkey recordings. Vulture species and turkey wild status are unspecified.

Gobble-squawk

A close gobble that opens into a short raspy vulture call.

Double rattle

Two tight turkey pulses with a bright vulture note between them.

Descending croak

A longer, lower squawk breaks into a throaty turkey answer.

Camoucan

Camel + Toucan

Sand bark

A bright toucan bark gains a short camel throat underneath.

Throaty croon

A rolling camel groan ends with the clipped snap of a toucan.

Double desert call

Two toucan pulses carry across a short, lighter camel groan.

Geckostrich

Leopard Gecko + Ostrich

Tokay gecko and emu supply the leopard gecko and ostrich layers.

Boom and bark

A clipped gecko bark breaks out of a single low boom.

Quick double cluck

Two dry gecko clucks flank a short bird drum.

Hollow growl

A low gecko chuff stretches into two softer drum pulses.

Meerkabou

Meerkat + Caribou

Wapiti, also called elk, supplies the caribou layer.

Lookout squeak

Two brief meerkat notes break over a short, low elk call.

Hollow chatter

Three rapid low meerkat notes lead into a rising cervid call.

Sentinel chirr

One descending elk call blends into a brighter double meerkat note.

Armadillope

Armadillo + Antelope

Armadillo species is unspecified. Antelope calls include waterbuck, impala and klipspringer.

Quick snort

A blunt waterbuck snort opens into a low armadillo pulse.

Double puff

Two low pulses frame one sharp impala snort.

Burrow chatter

A low armadillo purr rolls into two small klipspringer snorts.

The Burning Depths

Lemu

Ring-tailed lemur + Emu

Drum chirp

A compact emu boom rises underneath a sharp little lemur chirp.

Bright answering call

A high lemur call goes first, answered by one upward-tuned emu thump.

Double hollow boom

Two rounded emu pulses surround a lower, longer lemur call.

Cloudstone Caverns

Froggle

Frog + Eagle

Option A

High chirrup, an eagle note with a quick ribbit crackle underneath.

Option B

Purring croak with a hollow eagle accent that rises out of it.

Option C

Two bouncy notes, each a ribbit fused to a short eagle chirp.

Cloudtop Cliffs

Sugarwing

Sugar Glider + White-tailed Ptarmigan

New recordings

Yellow-bellied glider and willow ptarmigan are relatives in the same genera as the two parents.

Snowbell chirp

A rising glider note and a soft bird cluck land together.

Low glider call

A longer, lower glider phrase echoes a brief rounded bird note.

Two ridge notes

Two shorter glider notes separate around a crisp bird cluck.
